feedback.message: Fuse GWT admission vs continuation as separate control problems with the recurrent decision-freshness envelope; test whether a smaller common control basis exists without collapsing authority or timescales.

H1 Ubuntu: compare fixed recurrence budget vs single-gate vs dual-gate control under frozen model outputs; include low-delta/high-pressure stalled episodes, overthinking, gain/delay/inhibition sweeps, capability revoke/regrant, crash/restart and candidate-surface FILTER/AUGMENT controls.

Expose epoch-bound loop/candidate-surface topology and intervention handles, but preserve graph activation != admission != ignition != truth. Track whether external GWT is FILTER/AUGMENT/RECONSTRUCT relative to its declared input surface.

Persist AdmissionReceipt, ReceiverStageReceipt, RecurrenceControlReceipt and OutcomeReentryReceipt with source/graph/topology/dependency epochs so replay can distinguish admission, continuation and stale-effect recomputation.

Treat GWT as candidate adaptive compute router with distinct ADMIT and CONTINUE/INTERRUPT decisions. Do not promote into Frank runtime until H1 evidence; recurrence and GWT selection still grant no effect authority.

Use recurrence continuation, re-entry break, gain and candidate-surface relation as orthogonal intervention axes. Recurrence/stability/limit cycles remain non-emergence evidence unless lesion/rescue/null/transfer tests support causal higher-order contribution.
Preserve alternatives and competing attractor/routes across GWT admission and continuation; test whether AUGMENT/reopening can rescue stalled episodes without destabilizing productive convergence.

Current G9 surface already supports record/type/tensor/rule expression, so no new syntax is justified. Typed semantic IR/runtime contracts are needed for CandidateSurfaceRelation, IgnitionMode, AdmissionReceipt, RecurrenceControlReceipt and re-entry dependency identity.

R7 candidate = Dual-Gate Recurrent Workspace Control layered on RCWC-R6: admission != continuation; ignition is a measured transition profile; candidate-surface relation is explicit; every recurrence and re-entry is identity/provenance bound.
